decision.rationale: V2 improved region nDCG and text controls but failed the predeclared requirement to exceed V0 complete-evidence success by at least 15 percentage points. Run conditional V3 on failed slices and fixed controls; keep held-out unopened.
limitations: The 16-case development sample does not support a held-out generalization claim.
Whole-page V0 boxes can receive non-zero IoU and therefore overstate precise visual grounding.
Descriptions are unreviewed non-authoritative ranking metadata.
Deployed RSS, concurrency, revocation, and full-vault package size remain unmeasured.
